methods.label: Represent the addition law with letters
methods.explanation: The commutative property of addition states that when two numbers are added, exchanging the positions of the addends does not change the sum. Using the letters \(a\) and \(b\), it is expressed as \(a+b=b+a\).
methods.levelReason: The method expresses a familiar arithmetic law using letters, directly matching Grade 7 scope.
